# Compliance as Code
Compliance as code keeps controls executable and reviewable.

## Definition
Compliance evidence is captured close to the work and checked continuously.
Teams use policy files, review records, and audit notes as durable evidence.

### Control Mapping
Each control maps to one owner, one evidence source, and one review cadence.

## Evidence Pipeline
Continuous compliance evidence moves from source systems into indexed notes.
The pipeline keeps compliance evidence fresh for reviewers.
